metadata.description: Offline / air-gapped .NET development plugins for Claude Code, specialized for legacy .NET Framework 4.7.2-4.8 WPF. Fork of christian289/dotnet-with-claudecode.

plugins.name: wpf-net472-airgap-dev-pack
plugins.description: Offline WPF toolkit for existing .NET Framework 4.7.2-4.8 solutions: local-only MCP knowledge server, legacy project detection/preservation, and dependency-free MVVM (no CommunityToolkit; DevExpress.Mvvm detection). Agents and skills for CustomControl, XAML styling, high-performance rendering, and MVVM.
